section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study sample: the initial sample was 352 participants, reduced to a final N = 347 (171 male, 176 female) after exclusions for intellectual prejudice and comprehension/language difficulties. Participants were young adolescents — elementary school students drawn from two state and three private schools, and the study included input from researchers and two Portuguese elementary teachers and a primary education coordinator.
